traps.label: half_true

group_note: All six are printed as one question with four short text options, so all six are plain_mcq; q123 alone adds a secondary type, because its pedigree chart must be read before anything can start. Demands were set against each other: q124, q125 and q126 are straight retrieval of one stored association and are all recall with single_step, while q128 differs in asking which of four neighbouring mechanisms an example illustrates, so it carries concept_discrimination. q123 and q127 are the only two whose answer is built rather than retrieved - q123 by applying the pedigree rules in a fixed order, recessive first and then location, q127 by grading four whole claims - which is why they alone carry multi_step_dependent and several_independent_checks. q123 is also the only member with a demonstrated shortcut, so elimination appears there and nowhere else. q124 carries no trap at all: its three wrong options are unrelated biosynthetic processes with no route into them, and an empty list is the honest answer.
